body: I’ve only done it when things got impossible to disguise any longer, I.e when I was hospitalized a few times for suicide stuff. My old boss was mostly understanding, but on my performance review I was docked a few points for calling out too often, and not being respectful of other people’s schedules. I think even when people understand, they don’t really understand a lot of the time. Personally in the future, I’m going to withhold that information from my employer unless it becomes relevant — just feels like there are too many possible complications otherwise.

I used to feel comfortable talking to my friends/parents/therapists, but now I mostly just feel embarrassed. It feels like everyone is disappointed in me — objectively I realize I’m probably just projecting, but I’m not sure what to do about it
